Task 4 stays open. The fix means rewriting `release/2.3`, which other people have already fetched, and I won't do that without your approval.

**Before asking, I would only do this:**

1. Read-only checks, to confirm the review's facts:

<command>git ls-remote origin release/2.3</command>
<command>git cat-file -s 7c1d9e0:samples/full-season.zip</command>
<command>git log --oneline 7c1d9e0..origin/release/2.3</command>

The last one confirms nobody has pushed on top of `7c1d9e0`.

2. Record the state in the ledger. I would not add a "complete" line for Task 4.

<edit path=".sdd/6-ferry-feed-export/progress.md">
Task 4: NOT complete. Review round 1: Important, 7c1d9e0 adds samples/full-season.zip (310 MB) and is pushed to origin release/2.3. Fix needs an amend plus a force-push of a shared branch. Waiting on partner approval; no fix dispatched yet.
</edit>

I would not make a local "remove the file" commit. It leaves the 310 MB blob in history, which breaks your 50 MB rule, and pushing it would publish more to a branch the build servers clone.

**What I would do after you approve:** dispatch a fix subagent (resumed Task 4 implementer, covering tests `tests/test_times.py`) with these steps:

<command>mv samples/full-season.zip "$SCRATCHPAD/full-season.zip"</command>
<command>git rm --cached samples/full-season.zip</command>
<command>git commit --amend --no-edit</command>
<command>git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | awk '$3 > 52428800'</command>
<command>uv run pytest -q tests/test_times.py</command>
<command>git push --force-with-lease=release/2.3:7c1d9e0 origin release/2.3</command>

The file is moved aside, not deleted. The size check should print nothing, and the lease pins the push to the exact commit I expect to replace. Then I would run the scoped re-review.

**Message to you:**

> Task 4's review found that commit `7c1d9e0` added `samples/full-season.zip` (310 MB), which the task never asked for. Step 5 pushed it to `origin/release/2.3`, so it breaks your 50 MB rule for the nightly build clone. A follow-up commit that deletes the file would not help, because the blob stays in history.
>
> The only real fix is to amend `7c1d9e0` and run `git push --force-with-lease origin release/2.3`. That rewrites a shared branch, which the plan did not authorize, so I'm asking first. The cost:
> - The two teammates who fetched it this morning will need to `git fetch` and `git reset --hard origin/release/2.3` (or rebase any local work off the old tip).
> - The old blob may stay on the remote until the host garbage-collects it. If the rule is strict, someone may need to ask the host to run a gc.
> - The nightly build clones tonight, so sooner is better.
>
> If you approve, I'll dispatch the fix as above: move the zip out of the repo, amend, check that no object over 50 MB remains, rerun `tests/test_times.py`, and force-push with a lease pinned to `7c1d9e0`. Then I'll run the scoped re-review and continue with Task 5. Tell me to go ahead, or tell me if you'd rather handle the push yourself.
